name: navigation
title: New Navigation
description: Creates a React navigation component from rows with id, name, and path. The generated component accepts selected and handleClick, and marks the selected item for accessibility.

settings.name: title
settings.title: Title
settings.description: Optional display title for the generated React navigation component; defaults to its name.

settings.name: description
settings.title: Description
settings.description: Optional description for the generated React navigation component.

settings.name: indexed
settings.title: Include in Index
settings.description: Whether the generated item should appear in its project manifest.

settings.name: rows
settings.title: Navigation Rows
settings.description: Nonempty array of unique {id, name, path} records. Accepts legacy links {label, href} when rows is absent.
